Yes, you're covered! As a Leafy Plus member, you have a **90-day guarantee** on plants ordered while your membership is active. Since your plant arrived 50 days ago, you're well within that window.

To claim: go to "My Orders," select the plant, and submit **at least two photos** (whole plant + close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days** and send you a free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock). The plant doesn't need to be returned.
